summary: The existing SVG .3 owner issue 4645 selects source preparation for a public-circle comparison at 100, 250 and 500 instances, with the unchanged current producer and shared-symbol versus expanded-geometry representations. All counts use one 410 by 510 viewBox; the command oracle refuses clipped geometry and the actual document control checks the viewBox, exact population/order, style/geometry, hit identity, live/export agreement and retained ownership. Six states preserve the 10 percent sparse-motion sequence, a separate counter pass, two warmup passes and five raw timing samples per state. The later selected protocol requires three fresh trials against one sealed artifact, shared-first/expanded-first/shared-first, yielding 108 state rows and 540 samples. The existing packager seals the corpus and trial order protocol into its workload identity. The page and driver share closed order selection and complete row/sample validation; order scopes checkpoints and downloaded selection readback. Inert Node controls exercise the real oracle, pre-launch parser, packager and refusal predicates. Source preparation does not qualify compiled execution or timing. Existing build/serve/driver actions need separate admission and the full 17-control route; normal packed three-browser CI does not execute this complete research stream. Primary reporting compares per-trial sparse-motion medians for 500/250 and shared/expanded, retaining all counts, samples, extrema and negative comparisons. Changed viewBox prevents historical timing comparison. No complex-glyph, CPU/frame/raster, allocation/GC, validation-versus-serialization, performance, GPU or installed-adoption acceptance follows. Producer API, producer limits, package versions and workflows are unchanged; prior witnesses, failures and closed profiling chain remain retained. The caller selection is named representationOrder to avoid shadowing by the existing local order() DOM reader. A maintained inert lexical-caller regression executes the real caller prefix and verbatim downstream calls, accepts default and both explicit orders, and rejects the original shadowing mutation for all three. The existing normal run.sh executes this source suite before package/browser work; helper-only parsing tests are insufficient for this binding. Source repair does not erase the original failed qualification or replace fresh complete runtime qualification.
title: Public-circle count scaling uses one sealed producer and bounded complete command trials
